messages:
IncBot: :rotating_light: SEV2 PAGE: cross-region-routing-anomaly — high error rate from EU -> APAC-1, large increase in tail latency and 5xx. Pager: @Sam (oncall)
Sam (oncall): on it. which signal triggered?
IncBot: alerts: eu-prod-health service: p95 latency up 7x, 5xx rate from eu source 18% (baseline 0.4%).
Aisha (network): saw a policy rollout at 2026-04-09T02:06Z from deploy-bot-weights. New geo policy "geo-v3" was applied 02:06:12Z. Operator diff shows eu weight set to 0 in a range update.
Jon (eng-runtime): route debug from two eu edges: `route_debug --src eu --show-policy` outputs:
```
policy=geo-v3 resolved_target=apac-1 weights={eu:0,apac:100,na:0}
```
multiple requests show backend=apac-1 and backend 502/504.
Maya (support): support queue seeing spike, customers in EU complaining of app slow/failed calls. Raising urgent customer comms.
Sam (oncall): Can we apply a short-circuit pin to restore eu->eu-west routing? I want minimal blast radius.
Aisha (network): I will apply `policy-pin eu->eu-west-1 priority=emergency-1761239999`. Doing dry-run then apply.
Aisha (network): applied emergency pin, propagated to control-plane. Pushing route refresh to edge proxies.
Jon (eng-runtime): flushed local route cache and restarted routing-agent on eu edges. Quick check: `curl -s -H "x-test-region: eu" https://edge.internal/route-check | jq .target` now returns `eu-west-1`.
Sam (oncall): re-running synthetic tests: before mitigation p95=1.8s, 5xx=18%. after mitigation p95=160ms, 5xx=0.8%. Seems recovered.
Maya (support): posting an update to affected customers: "We've applied a routing fix; services recovering. No data loss expected. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." @Ravi can you help with wording?
Ravi (product): LGTM. Note: we should avoid promising ETA for full rollback until we validate operator fix.
Aisha (network): operator audit: the range-update delta had a malformed multiplication by 0 when normalizing weights. deploy-bot-weights v1.9 shipped a change that mis-handled empty region lists. I'm rolling back that operator delta and patching validation.
Jon (eng-runtime): while Aisha reverts, I'm enabling canary routing: route-eval to 5% to eu-west-1 then ramp. Also setting autoscale +1 for eu-west frontends to handle burst.
IncNotes: actions so far: emergency pin applied by Aisha, route cache flush by Jon, autoscale bump in eu-west by Jon, operator delta reverted by Aisha. Incident owner assigned: Aisha.
Sam (oncall): any DNS effects? Could there be split-horizon where some resolvers cached older policy?
Aisha (network): good point. I'm lowering DNS TTL for edge service to 20s to accelerate propagation for EU clients. Also invalidating internal DNS cache in our resolver fleet.
Jon (eng-runtime): checking logs for asymmetric load — so far apac-1 shows drop in traffic after pin, but eu-west shows spike to 1.8x normal for 10 minutes. No overload alerts yet.
Maya (support): channel update: customers alerted, support triaging top accounts. No escalations to legal/compliance.
Sam (oncall): preparing handoff in 30 minutes. I'll stay until 03:00Z then hand off to Jon.
Aisha (network): pushing a short-term guard: pre-deploy hook to verify weight_sum==100 and region_presence checks. Also adding an alert if any region weight == 0 for >30s unexpectedly.
Jon (eng-runtime): adding a route-sampling telemetry metric to detect large sudden shifts in resolved_target distribution for a source region. Will add dashboard and alert.
Ravi (product): for customer comms, we should include root cause (operator weight-normalization bug), mitigations taken, and next steps (validation checks + RCA ticket). Ravi to coordinate follow-up email.
IncNotes: Severity: Sev2. Total customer impact window: ~7 minutes of elevated errors from 02:06:12Z to 02:13:00Z with mitigations at 02:10:30Z. Affected: EU region traffic to apac-1, several enterprise customers experienced failures.
Sam (oncall): handing off monitoring to Jon at 03:00Z. Leaving detailed runbook in incident doc.
Jon (eng-runtime): taking over. I'll keep watch on eu-west autoscale and route-sampling alert for next 2 hours. Opening RCA ticket: INC-1761239999-RCA.
IncBot: Incident closed for paging. RCA ticket created and linked. Incident note appended to #incidents/incidents-log."
